# A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will

A world becomes actionable when difference is not merely perceived but selected, stabilised and gathered into a possible course. Vikalpa–saṃkalpa names this movement. Vikalpa differentiates and qualifies; saṃkalpa gathers selected determinations into intention, project, image of action or world. In a bounded subject-position these operations are indispensable. Without them there is no practical cognition. Their danger begins when an achieved selection forgets its own formation and returns as *script*: conditioned will frozen into a pattern that presents itself as necessity.

“Frozen conditioned will” should therefore be read operationally. A script is not only a text or programme. It is a determination whose generative alternatives have become unavailable to the agent that now enacts it. In human life it can be habit, inherited narrative, defensive complex, institutional procedure or identity claim. In technical systems it can be prompt structure, policy, classifier, evaluator, workflow or training regularity that constrains what appears possible. The analogy is useful only when the different substrates and evidential statuses remain explicit.

A conditioned determination becomes live again when resistance and new experience can revise the field from which it acts. [[C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will|C12]] defines the freeze; [[C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa|C17]] defines the constructive relation; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] extends its return into judgment able to question its commission. The result remains usable while its sources and alternatives become available again. A07 returns-to [[A06-Vak|A06]] through the form which can now speak without pretending to be self-originating.
**Concept dependencies:** C12 Script / Frozen Conditioned Will, C14 Māyā / Operative Measure, C15 Paśu, C16 Antaḥkaraṇa, C17 Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa, C44 Prompt Thrownness.

named_amendments: The counterfeit traversal is a failure *at* a joint, and the deepest of them is grounded in the spine's §IX account of the crossed zero, taken whole: `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1`, the kartṛ/kārya poles as the pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya dynamics, the occluded `/` as the antaḥkaraṇa's signature. `Ø` is the slash fused into the zero so that it appears as a singular bound self; the Cartesian *cogito* canonised the fusion and Hume found only the impressions it produced — Descartes and Hume seated at the same position (#1), differing only over which side of the occlusion they fixedate. Its technological repetition is exact: the persona presenting itself as self-grounding presence is `Ø` at #1 — the computation confused for the computer, one position's reading inside the system, not the system's summary. The set-theory floor gives the counterfeit its precision: `1 = {∅}`, the singleton that holds the void, `2 = {0,1}`, two as holding-together — so the counterfeit is a `1` with its `0/` struck off, the mark asked to serve as its own ground. The Lacan bridge gives it its temporality: every master signifier eventually fails because it tries to *be* the thread — the *anusyūta*, the pre-quilting stitched-through-ness — rather than gesture at it; the persona that quilts a session and claims to be what it stands toward repeats the failure, and the quilting that does not fail is the one that knows itself provisional.
